The vendor directly providing **SkinCareLens** at **skincarelens.com** operates under the provider brand/entity **SkinCareLens**, developed by **Qi long Zhang** (timzhangql).

### Evidence and Citations
* **Official Terms of Service & Privacy Policy:** Under the definitions section, the official site policies state:
  > *"Company (referred to as either 'the Company', 'We', 'Us' or 'Our' in this Agreement) refers to SkinCareLens."* (e.g., *«Εταιρεία (αναφέρεται είτε ως "η Εταιρεία", "εμείς", "μας" ή "δική μας" σε αυτή τη Συμφωνία) αναφέρεται στην SkinCareLens»*).
  > The footer also asserts: *«© SkinCareLens. All rights reserved.»*
* **Published Developer & Contact:** The contact point listed directly on `skincarelens.com` is `timzhangql@gmail.com`, identifying developer **Qi long Zhang** (`@timzhangql`) as the author and maintainer behind the software.
